Before you order

What is in the kit?

The model specification lists the walls, floor, windows, doors, roof structure, fixings and instructions. The final roof covering is quoted separately.

When will it be ready?

For made-to-order kits, the supplier estimates 1.5–2 months after the deposit. Factory readiness, delivery and installation are confirmed separately.

What does the site need?

Allow room for vehicle access and unloading. The foundation depends on the plot. Check local building requirements with the municipality using the cadastral reference.

Can I use it in winter?

The base kit is for seasonal use. Winter use calls for a review of the structure, insulation, heating and ventilation.

How do you protect it from rain?

Gutters, drainage away from the foundation and timber treatment can be included to suit the site.

What do I get before paying?

A written quote, the model specification, agreed dates and the contract terms.
